question.en: Discuss the significance of the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) in the context of targeted welfare delivery in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) in the context of targeted welfare delivery in India.

modelAnswer.en: SECC provides granular data on household deprivation. It helps in moving from universal to targeted welfare, reducing leakages, and ensuring that benefits reach the most vulnerable sections based on specific indicators like landlessness and housing quality.
